title: Combat Action
description: Defines a combat action, attack, or maneuver that can be performed during combat using the unified SW5e x FFG system.

name.description: The display name of the combat action.

action_category.description: The category of combat action for organization and filtering.

difficulty.description: The difficulty level of performing this combat action.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of what the combat action represents and how it feels to perform. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this combat action, often from Star Wars lore.

description.description: Detailed mechanical description of what the combat action does and its rules.

type.description: The type of combat action this represents.

cost.description: The types of action resources this can be spent on.

prerequisites.description: Requirements that must be met to use this combat action.

initiative_modifiers.description: How this action affects initiative or is affected by initiative.

initiative_bonus.description: Bonus to initiative rolls when using this action.

initiative_penalty.description: Penalty to initiative rolls when using this action.

initiative_advantage.description: Whether this action grants advantage on initiative.

initiative_disadvantage.description: Whether this action imposes disadvantage on initiative.

movement_requirements.description: Movement requirements and effects for this action.

required_movement.description: Minimum movement required to use this action.

movement_cost.description: Movement cost to use this action.

difficult_terrain_penalty.description: Whether this action is affected by difficult terrain.

cover_interactions.description: How this action interacts with cover.

ignores_cover.description: Types of cover this action ignores.

cover_bonus.description: Bonus when using this action from cover.

creates_cover.description: Whether this action creates cover for allies.

destroys_cover.description: Whether this action can destroy cover.

environmental_factors.description: How environmental conditions affect this action.

terrain_effects.description: How different terrain types affect this action.

effect.description: How this terrain affects the action.

weather_effects.description: How weather conditions affect this action.

effect.description: How this weather affects the action.

hazard_interactions.description: How hazards interact with this action.

effect.description: How this hazard affects the action.

combat_conditions.description: How combat conditions affect this action.

advantage.description: Whether this action has advantage against prone targets.

disadvantage.description: Whether this action has disadvantage when prone.

advantage.description: Whether this action has advantage against invisible targets.

disadvantage.description: Whether this action has disadvantage when invisible.

can_use.description: Whether this action can be used while grappled.

restrictions.description: Restrictions when using this action while grappled.

can_use.description: Whether this action can be used while restrained.

restrictions.description: Restrictions when using this action while restrained.

target.description: Defines the targeting parameters for this combat action.

area.description: For area effects, defines the shape and size.

attack.description: Attack parameters if this is an attack action.

attack_modifier.description: The ability modifier used for the attack roll.

damage_reduction.description: How this attack interacts with damage reduction.

bypasses_resistance.description: Damage types this attack bypasses resistance for.

bypasses_immunity.description: Damage types this attack bypasses immunity for.

damage_reduction.description: Amount of damage reduction this attack ignores.

effects.description: The mechanical results of taking this combat action, using our master effects schema.

value.description: The specific effect value or identifier.

target_scopes.description: Who or what this effect applies to.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for this effect to apply.

narrative_currency.description: How this action generates and spends narrative currency (Advantage/Threat).

advantage_generation.description: Conditions that generate Advantage when using this action.

threat_generation.description: Conditions that generate Threat when using this action.

advantage_spends.description: Valid Advantage spends for this action.

threat_spends.description: Valid Threat spends for this action.

narrative_outcomes.description: List of IDs for valid Advantage/Threat spends when using this combat action.

synergies.description: Special combinations that enhance this combat action.

requirement.description: The specific requirement for this synergy.

description.description: Description of how this synergy works.

balance_considerations.description: Balance considerations for this combat action.

power_level.description: Relative power level of this action.

action_economy_impact.description: How this action affects action economy.

counterplay_options.description: Available counterplay options against this action.

testing_notes.description: Notes for testing this action's balance.

class_synergies.description: Classes that have special interactions with this combat action.

species_synergies.description: Species that have special interactions with this combat action.

faction_synergies.description: Factions that have special interactions with this combat action.

iconic_usage.description: Example of how this combat action is typically used in Star Wars lore.

tactical_notes.description: Tactical advice for when and how this combat action is most effective.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this combat action.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying characters performing this combat action.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this combat action, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this combat action adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Combat_Scene', 'Location').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this combat action is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the combat action's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the combat action's icon for UI display.

color.description: Primary color for UI elements (hex code or color name).
